title: The Vanished Sourdough
scene: At 8:20 AM, the prize sourdough loaf vanished from the cooling rack. The hearth oven takes 45 minutes to bake a batch of croissants.

suspects.name: Bryn Holloway
suspects.testimony: I dusted flour on the marble counter right beside the cooling rack from 8:05 to 8:25 AM.
suspects.alibiProof: The morning cashier watched Bryn rolling dough beside the rack continuously from 8:05 to 8:25 AM.

suspects.name: Keiko Sato
suspects.testimony: I steamed milk at the espresso bar from 8:00 to 8:30 AM and never walked to the back kitchen.
suspects.alibiProof: Four regular customers ordered lattes from Keiko at the front bar between 8:00 and 8:30 AM.

suspects.name: Tomas Vega
suspects.testimony: I unloaded flour sacks by the alley door from 8:05 to 8:25 AM, keeping the van engine off.
suspects.alibiProof: The alley security camera shows Tomas unloading flour sacks continuously from 8:05 to 8:25 AM.

suspects.name: Duncan Farrell
suspects.testimony: I slid raw croissants into the hearth oven at 8:00 AM and pulled them out fully baked at 8:25 AM.
suspects.contradiction: A 45-minute bake started at 8:00 AM finishes at 8:45 AM, and the sourdough was in Duncan's crate.
